_comment: The five reports, and the columns that identify each one. This file is the
single definition: build.sh inlines it into the page, and the on-prem
importer reads it directly. Both therefore agree by construction about what
makes a file the LMS export — they cannot drift.
`must` is the signature. A sheet carrying every one of those columns is that
report, whatever the file is called. Add an alias by widening `must`, never
